notes: No approved real-model baseline exists yet for the v0.3 pipeline.
The published v0.2-alpha result (Cohen's kappa 0.687, 83% true-positive
recall on 265 labeled alerts) was produced by scripts/benchmark_quants.py,
which uses a stale copy of the v0.2 prompt, sends raw unisolated alerts,
does not run the prefilter, and coerces invalid model output into
'uncertain'. It therefore does not describe the pipeline shipping in v0.3
and must not be adopted as a threshold.
Next step: run 'python3 scripts/gold_gate.py evaluate' on the operator
host, review the measured pipeline and model-only metrics, then set
thresholds and flip status to 'approved' in a separate reviewed change.
While status is 'uncalibrated' the deterministic Layer 1 checks still run
on every pull request, but no performance threshold is enforced.
'gold_gate.py verify --require-calibrated' fails in this state, so release
evidence collection cannot mistake an uncalibrated gate for an approved one.
